title: Make common report SQL persistence usable on an isolated fresh database
description: Stage 1 common report platform runtime persistence increment. A real dedicated localdb probe found fresh startup blocked by a legacy EF table-name mismatch in SchemaUpgrader, before report APIs are usable. User 2026-10-04 autonomous authorization permits this exact development-only bootstrap repair; it is not a bespoke business report or audit-only task. Modify only the named upgrade code and regression/integration tests. No production DB connection, arbitrary SQL, secrets/config/.env modifications, migrations, schema changes executed outside the isolated test instance, business writes outside test fixtures, Agent, deployment or stage-2 migration. Preserve all existing fields and permissions and do not suppress startup errors. Existing reporting Domain/Application/Infrastructure mappings require no changes. Localdb SQL Server 15.0.4382.1 has been created separately from MSSQLSERVER. Set test flags and connection only in child processes, include dedicated target guard, and retain ERP-190 completion and deferred ERP-257/258.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh isolated SQL Server database can finish NEWERP startup so the common report configuration module is usable. Correct the proven SchemaUpgrader section 28 mismatch: EF maps db_owner.ContainerBookings but twelve COL_LENGTH/ALTER checks address nonexistent db_owner.ContainerBooking (SQL error 4902 at line 1406). Align the existing upgrade target with EF mapping without creating a duplicate singular table, moving entities, hiding exceptions, skipping upgrades wholesale, or changing business behavior. Verify rerun is idempotent.

Add meaningful offline mapping/bootstrap regression coverage and dedicated SQL Server integration coverage for common report definition save/read, draft version update and published revision persistence with owner scope and unauthorized read rejection. Fixtures must assert a dedicated localdb NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database before writes; use process-only test connection settings, never appsettings/.env or production credentials. Existing report entities/DbSets/mappings/services suffice; no new persistence model or business dataset.

Run focused tests, safe Release build/test and scheduler self-test/contracts. Use prepared localdb instance NEWERP_AutoAcceptance, NEWERP_AUTOTEST_20261004; record real SQL results and full startup logs. The first probe already materialized common report tables but failed at section 28; no API is currently listening on 5067. Do not claim first-stage complete or browser acceptance. If another unrelated legacy bootstrap defect appears, preserve exact evidence and apply only the minimal startup correction needed within the allowed source file.

human_gate.reason: Explicit autonomous development authorization, isolated test target only; no production execution.

recovery_context.instruction: DeepSeek supervisor recovery: inspect the referenced complete logs, diagnose the root cause, and implement a different safe repair within allowed_paths. Rebuild and rerun the configured tests; if validation fails, use the newest log as the next repair input. Do not repeat the failed approach. Do not edit task/state/result files or relax production and irreversible-operation gates.
